spec2def(ntlanman.dll ntlanman.spec)

# ntlanman.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ntlanman-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(ntlanman_shims OBJECT ntlanman.c)
target_link_libraries(ntlanman_shims PRIVATE wine libnetapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(ntlanman_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(ntlanman ntlanman-cargo ntlanman.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ntlanman_shims psdk)
